environment.description: Same container deployed on RHEL 9.3 CoreOS node with enforcing SELinux policy (targeted mode) using custom type 'tfprovider_diag_t'. The process transition is defined via a type_transition rule from container_runtime_t to tfprovider_diag_t on exec. The tfprovider_diag_t domain has: (1) tcp_socket permissions limited to bind/listen/accept on port labeled tfdiag_port_t (8443), (2) file read access ONLY to objects labeled tfstate_file_t under /var/lib/terraform-provider/state/, (3) NO write permission to any network socket payload beyond the initial HTTP response headers defined in the allow rule (tfprovider_diag_t self:tcp_socket { read write }), (4) httpd_content_t label on /proc/self/fd stdout prevents script-injected content from being served as text/html — the response body is relabeled by the SELinux-aware HTTP proxy (Envoy with SELinux socket labeling) which enforces that outbound responses from tfprovider_diag_t matching Content-Type text/html must pass through an eBPF content filter (Cilium L7 policy with HTML entity encoding on reflected parameters). Additionally, the node runs an AppArmor profile 'terraform-provider-diag' in complain mode that logs but does not block.

config.envoy_sidecar: v1.28 with ext_authz filter checking response content-type
